summary: conv-context-next preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (`_0xXXXX` identifiers) and, on install, selects a Bun binary for the current platform/arch, downloads it from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at a pinned version, unzips it, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a rotated string-array and character-decoder consistent with obfuscator.io output; it is not referenced by the library entrypoint `index.js` and its filename does not correspond to the package's advertised conversation-context purpose. Executing the payload under a freshly downloaded Bun runtime hides it from Node-based dependency scanners, since Node never loads the bundle. Package name `conv-context-next` differs from the name used throughout its own README (`conv-context`), the `author` field is empty, and the tarball otherwise mirrors a small lodash-based helper — consistent with a typosquat republish with a dropper appended.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
